title: very good app
body: I have anxiety, ptsd, autism and ocd and this app is so calming and has all I need. I assume the community tab is optional and it is great to not have that distraction whilst meditating. Thank you
author: claudebutterfly

title: Loving it!
body:
I am grateful to have found Evolve.
I am in a life transition, anxiety is strong. 
I have obsessive thoughts.
This daily program gives me soothing, and to surround myself with gentleness.
author: Kensington10
